description: Cold email outreach tool — Gmail sending, scheduler, tracking, reply detection
//overrides: `googleapis` depends on google-auth-library ^10.2.0 while its own
`googleapis-common` pins it to exactly 10.5.0, so npm installs TWO copies.
TypeScript then sees two structurally identical but nominally distinct
OAuth2Client classes (they have private fields, so structural matching does
not apply) and rejects passing our client to google.gmail({ auth }).
Pinning one version collapses them into a single declaration.
